youtube_title: Crystal Lake's Dole Mansion: an 1865 grain baron's house and the figure people say they've seen
body: A figure in Victorian dress. That's what some people say they've seen at the Dole Mansion in Crystal Lake, Illinois. It was built in 1865 for Charles Dole, a Chicago grain merchant, and later ice was cut from the lake there and shipped to Chicago. In 1922, a group that included Lou Ringling, widow of circus co-founder Al Ringling, turned it into a country club. Later, Franciscans ran a boys' school there, and in 2002 the community raised the money to save it from a condo developer. Some believe Lou Ringling never left. A staff member has described drastic temperature changes, and visitors tell of a figure in Victorian dress. Not everyone believes it. Today the Dole is an arts center, open to the public. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #CrystalLake #McHenryCounty #Illinois #Haunted #History #LaPorteAfterDark
